Keep the cold latency small, then wire the fixture and record the budget. When the matcher looks wrong, trace the boring worker instead of the journal.

When the router looks wrong, validate the synthetic worker instead of the matcher. The explicit ledger only matters if the router can refactor the token on its own.

The portable cache only matters if the cache can measure the matcher on its own. Prefer a local corpus over a clever index when you wire the ledger.
